Quarterly Financial Supplement Second Quarter 2026 Segment Reporting Changes Related to International Businesses Segment In August 2026, the Company announced its intent to exit certain of its Emerging Markets businesses previously included within the International Businesses segment. As a result, effective in the third quarter of 2026, (i) the operating results of certain businesses, including its Brazil and Mexico operations, are reflected in Other Divested and Run-off Businesses included within Corporate and Other operations, and (ii) the former International Businesses segment has been renamed “Japan Businesses.” In connection with this change, the results of the Company’s indirect 40% ownership interest in Administradora de Fondos de Pensiones Habitat S.A. ("AFP Habitat"), previously included within the International Businesses’ segment results, are now included within the Retirement segment results. The previously reported International Businesses and restated Japan Businesses Statements of Operation can be found on pages iv and v, respectively. The impact of the Emerging Market businesses, excluding AFP Habitat, on historical results, and the impact of AFP Habitat, now reflected in Retirement, can be found on pages vi and vii, respectively. The updates made for these revisions are highlighted in yellow throughout Exhibit 99.1. iii Table of Contents Prudential Financial, Inc. reference.summary: Prudential Financial, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides financial products and services in the United States, Japan and internationally. It operates through PGIM, Retirement Strategies, Group Insurance, Individual Life, and International Businesses segments. The PGIM segment offers investment management services and solutions related to public fixed income, public equity, real estate debt and equity, private credit and other alternatives, and multi-asset class strategies to institutional and retail clients, as well as its insurance and retirement businesses.
